summary:
Okay, so I just built a trading bot by combining GrokBot and Unibot into one terminal.

And somehow this thing already made me $12K in just 48 hours lol.
Basically, Grok handles the intelligence while Unibot executes the trades.

Here's what I added:
→ GROK SCOUT finds coins trending on X
→ SNIPER buys tokens right at launch
→ CURVE trades the bonding curve
→ GRADUATE sells once a token graduates

But here's the interesting part. It actually knows when NOT to buy.

Dev holds more than 10%? Skipped.
Over 25% bundled? Skipped.
Wallet connected to an old rug? Skipped.

It also sends me updates on every trade and asks if I want to keep going once my profit target is reached.

I can literally talk to it like I'm talking to a friend and tell it what to buy, sell, or avoid.
People are still paying for Telegram alpha calls while I'm building something that finds opportunities, filters out potential rugs, and executes trades without waiting for someone to drop a contract address.

That's literally the problem I wanted to solve.

Still testing a few things, but $12K in 48 hours is pretty crazy. Obviously, that doesn't guarantee it'll keep performing like this.

I think I accidentally built something interesting here.

title: 🆕 New Pair: 0xEc383A25b6434216ea... on robinhood
summary:
Sodi is private leverage for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. You deposit a stock token and borrow against it. The money you borrow goes into a shielded pool instead of your wallet, so whatever you do with it can’t be traced back to the position. The next stage hides the position itself: it becomes a private note, proven solvent with zero-knowledge proofs against Chainlink prices.

The same pool lets AI agents pay privately. An agent opens a session from the pool and pays x402 endpoints, including Sodi’s own inference gateway, from a fresh address each time, so no merchant can link it to its owner. 

The network is run by operators who screen deposits, relay withdrawals and serve inference. They bond $SODI to do it, and 1.5% of every $SODI trade is bought back and burned.

title: 🆕 New Pair: GVEQKeEm2MeSVYQP3FM3... on solana
summary:
Every coin gets a GO check before it flies.

Go-Pad is a fair launchpad on top of pumpdotfun. Before a coin is created, six stations answer GO or NO-GO: no copied ticker, no copied name, no copied picture, no ticker that already trades, and one launch per wallet a day.

No dev buy. Coins are created by Go-Pad's own wallet, so there is no creator bag to dump, and launching is free.

The creation transaction goes out as a private bundle, so no one can buy in the block the coin is born.

Creator fees are split 50/50 on chain: half goes to the coin's creator, half buys the coin back and burns it. Every fee, buyback and burn is recorded on a public ledger.

Not financial advice.
